basis: User product requirements and observed public UI, not server implementation

cases.expect: Existing desktop entry remains usable; second launch leaves one character; no index update or external search
Composition Enter/Space/digit and input/change/blur issue zero submissions; explicit send issues exactly one; Shift+Enter preserves newline; synthetic coverage is not native IME
A session recalls a supplied test nickname and follows up on RAG; another session cannot recall that nickname
Reset clears only the selected conversation; late data cannot restore it
Hiding and reopening preserves draft and completed answer
While busy answer panel is hidden; status closes before full answer autoopens; right menu stop available
Natural language and advanced filters retain the same current results/context; displayed, validated and candidate counts are distinguishable
Type, explicit folder and complete identifier are hard constraints; daily files and no-match queries do not require course-specific rules
Only PDF then modification sort reuse current result context; selection remains bound to the correct file identity
Only target task stops; old completion cannot write back; other tasks remain active and complete normally
Date/time/timezone reflect actual host, without external search
Today/tomorrow range is local timezone; real query is read-only; denial/empty/failure are distinguished in isolated scenarios; no private text logs
Default off; toggle alone issues zero search; daily eligibility is separate from exhausted developer lock; shared persistent rolling30, failure counts, cache and pre-send blocks do not count
Independent local chat and filename search retain answer ownership, aggregate busy state and file identity
Chat plus real semantic search can queue; real embedding used, no false completion, no cross-history
Cancel/reset one session does not cancel another, clear its state, or reopen stale answers

prior_manual_confirmation.calendar_final_entry: User confirms final entry authorized, clock and calendar work

coverage_rule: Unavailable native automation is uncovered, never an automatic pass; external dependencies may be isolated HTTP simulators, not internal final-state injection
